data.name: Profane Studies
data.description: Your study of fiends grants you advantages when summoning or fighting them. You gain a +5 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks involving evil outsiders. Additionally, when you cast a summon monster spell to summon an evil outsider, treat your caster level as 2 levels higher for the purpose of determining the duration.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Ability to cast a summon monster spell.
